design_principles: STABLE -> RELIABLE -> SIMPLE -> FAST -> SECURE -> EASY TO USE
Aksesibilitas Tinggi: Tombol besar (min-height 48px), kontras tinggi (APCA/WCAG AA 4.5:1+), font sans-serif karya anak bangsa Plus Jakarta Sans yang sangat legible untuk lansia dan pengguna awam.
Buleleng Regency Red Accent: Gunakan warna Merah Buleleng (#C81E1E / #DC2626) sebagai identitas visual utama, dipadukan dengan latar bersih (#F8FAFC) dan kartu putih solid (#FFFFFF) ber-shadow halus.
Desain Komponen Card-Based Modern: Border radius 12px (rounded-xl), 1px stroke border (#E2E8F0), shadow-sm ringan tanpa gradien gelap yang membingungkan.
Mobile First & Responsive: Touch target ramah jari, sidebar berubah menjadi drawer/mobile menu, tabel horizontal-scrollable, multi-step wizard dengan progress bar jelas.
Data Testing Ready: Semua elemen interaktif dan data penting wajib memiliki attribute data-testid (misal: data-testid='submit-survey-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NOTE FOR REACT FILES: The project uses .js or .jsx file extension (NOT .tsx). Ensure imports match .js/.jsx syntax.
ALWAYS USE data-testid: Add data-testid='...' to all buttons, inputs, modals, table rows, tab triggers, and key metrics.
NON-TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS: Never use background transparent on floating menus, dropdowns, sticky headers, or modals. Always use solid white (#FFFFFF) with border (#E2E8F0) and shadow-lg.
FONT LOADING: Ensure Plus Jakarta Sans is loaded via HTML Google Fonts link or @import in index.css.
LARGE TOUCH TARGETS FOR PUBLIC SURVEY: Buttons in public survey must be min 48px height with clear active/focus states for accessibility.
DATA MASKING: Mask NIK (e.g., 510801******0001) and Phone Numbers (e.g., 0812****5678) in public-facing or default respondent lists with a toggle to unmask for authorized admin.
TOAST NOTIFICATIONS: Use Sonner for global toasts (e.g. toast.success('Survei berhasil dikirim!'), toast.error('...')).
SKELETON & LOADING STATES: Every chart, KPI card, and table must render skeleton loaders while data fetching.
